notes.title: The Idiot's Tale - Soundtrack, Steam Deck, and Sale, Oh My!
notes.content:
Greets to thee! Remember that time we made a point-and-click adventure game? So do we!

While the game itself remains perfect and in need of absolutely no bugfixes whatsoever, we wanted to let you know about some [i]The Idiot's Tale[/i]-adjacent content! Woots all around!

[list]
[*] The official [i]Idiot's Tale[/i] soundtrack is now available on Steam! You can download the 16-track masterpiece in MP3 format (or lossless WAV format if you have Very Good Ears (TM)).
[*] We've tested [i]The Idiot's Tale[/i] out on Steam Deck, and it runs beautifully! Now you can take Sir Quest on the go! Play [i]The Idiot's Tale[/i] in many exciting locations, such as the grocery store or the post office!
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32131671/510996f0a81a001876fbed5d5b847e8fd8c0397e.jpg[/img]

[list]
[*] Finally, to celebrate all this Miscellaneous Hubbub, [i]The Idiot's Tale[/i] is 33% off for this week only!
[/list]

That's all! Now scram!
